sentence: أريد إدارة العملاء: الاسم إلزامي وفريد، والبريد والهاتف والعنوان اختيارية، مع قائمة قابلة للبحث والترتيب، ونموذج إنشاء وتعديل، وصفحة تفاصيل، وحذف منطقي، وصلاحيات بحيث يرى الموظف عملاء وحدته فقط ويعدّل المدير.
rule: plain AdonisJS 7 + Inertia React from the official inertia-react starter, without @adula/kit or @adula/ui, PostgreSQL 17
built: units, users.role/unit_id and customers migrations; Customer model with soft delete and partial unique index on lower(name); policy, VineJS validators, controller, transformer; 7 routes; RTL Arabic index/create/edit/show pages
guessedRequirements: managers limited to their own unit
case-insensitive name uniqueness excluding soft-deleted rows
unit taken from the creating user
only managers delete; no restore screen
deviations: plain accessible HTML instead of shadcn/ui
limits: The agent is the same model family that wrote the kit; the plan measures the agent's time and the human review time, and only the first is recorded here.
